text:
Samir: heads up — I noticed the next-orientation starter kit isn't sending telemetry on the edge build. console shows no 'app_started' or 'init_sdk' events after deploy.
Mia: which SDK/version and runtime?
Samir: using redwood-js SDK v0.6.1, running on Vercel Edge (edge runtime). local dev server shows events, prod edge doesn't. quick repro:
Samir: ```ts
// pages/_app.tsx snippet
useEffect(() => {
  RedwoodTelemetry.init({ apiKey: process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_RW_API_KEY });
}, []);
```
Alex: thanks — could be missing polyfill or init order on edge. the Python starter pings at import time so parity gap plausible. did you open an issue?
Samir: filed one: https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood/issues/6712 with logs + minimal deploy link.
Jules: I also saw different retry behavior between the Node and Python SDKs — Node maxAttempts=3 but it sometimes nukes streaming responses on retry, causing duplicate tokens. probably related to how we re-open the request stream.
Mia: hmm. can you paste the config you're using for retries?
Jules: ```js
client = new RedwoodClient({ retry: { attempts: 3, backoffFactor: 2 } })
```
Samir: quick experiment: bumping to redwood-js v0.6.3 and moving init into a top-level import fixed the edge telemetry for me (locally and in a preview).
DevEx Bot: CI passed for PR #4821 (samples: next-orientation-kit telemetry init).
Alex: good — but we need an automated check. propose adding an eval-harness test that deploys the starter to a preview env and asserts telemetry events show up in STAGING telemetry sink. Also update README to call out SDK init requirement for edge runtimes.
Mia: agree. small follow-ups: 1) add init snippet to starter _app.tsx, 2) update CHANGELOG for JS SDK parity fixes, 3) add a non-flaky retry test for streaming.
Jules: I'll take README + eval-harness test. assigning to @Jules — ETA: tomorrow EOD.
Samir: thanks — saved me a bunch of spinning in prod. :thumbsup:
Mia: can you also include the minimal repro and the Vercel edge logs in the issue? that'll help infra triage.
Samir: done, added logs and the preview URL.
Alex: filing follow-up issue to align retry semantics across SDKs and ensure streaming-safe retries. created #6720.
Jules: noted. I'll link both issues in the PR.
Samir: sounds good. I'll validate the preview after PR lands and report back.
Mia: lovely — thanks everyone.
